name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-deveco-bridge
description: HarmonyOS DevEco toolchain bridge for dsh: runs hvigor/ohpm/hdc via node:child_process (no native addons), exposing dev_environment/dev_build/dev_install_deps/dev_deploy/dev_list_devices/dev_code tools (dev_code delegates sub-tasks to the local DevEco Code agent over HTTP).
